policy: Retain every quality_gate_v2 extraction/dedup/retrieval/routing/SQL threshold. Add previously unconfigured task-label thresholds before source-disjoint holdout prediction.
unknowns: Missing class measurements are NOT_RUN and block release. UNKNOWN and failed rows remain in full joint accuracy; known-label coverage is reported separately.
review: Delegated Agent source review, not human verification. Source-disjoint holdout has sparse engineering positives and does not establish domain-wide accuracy.
deployment: Module passage alone never overrides the aggregate release blocker or the disabled Fast Decision policy. Historical v2 reports remain replayable under v2.
